statement_en: As the carbohydrate-to-lipid ratio in the feed increased, the feed intake of mandarin fish in the D3 group was significantly higher than that in other treatment groups.
statement_zh: 随着饲料中碳水化合物与脂质比例的升高，D3组鳜鱼的摄食量显著高于其他处理组。

statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, mixed diets with a higher proportion of formulated feed improved growth performance at the end of the experiment, with hepatic IGF-I gene expression following body growth. Brain NPY was also upregulated in hybrid mandarin fish given more formulated feed; the claims do not state feeding conditions or ratios.
statement_zh: 在一项鳜鱼研究中,混合饲料中配合饲料比例提高,试验结束时生长性能显著改善,肝脏IGF-I基因表达与鱼体生长一致。杂交鳜投喂配合饲料比例更高的饲料后,脑内NPY表达也上调;这些结论未说明具体的投喂条件或比例。

practice_en: individual tank scheduled and quantified feeding
practice_zh: 单缸饲养定时定量投喂
statement_en: Each mandarin fish was housed individually in an aquarium, and up to 3 bait fish were fed daily at 5:30 PM.
statement_zh: 每条鳜鱼单独饲养在一个水族箱中，每天下午5:30最多投喂3条饵料鱼。

statement_en: The claims on inducing mandarin fish to eat artificial feed are mixed: some say fish can accept artificial feed after acclimation and that certain mechanisms aid adaptation, but others report that domestication is difficult, with uneven sizes, low survival, body weight and length differences between groups, and higher expression of anorexia genes (mc4r, htr1b, lgr4) in fish that were hard to domesticate. Most claims describe difficulties or group differences rather than a clear welfare benefit, and no conditions are given.
statement_zh: 关于诱导鳜鱼吞食人工饲料,现有结论并不一致:有的说驯化后鳜鱼能够接受人工饲料,某些机制也有利于其适应;但另一些指出驯化难度大,个体规格不整齐、成活率低,不同组间体重和体长差异显著,且难驯化组中厌食基因(mc4r、htr1b、lgr4)表达上调。多数结论强调的是驯化困难或组间差异,并未明确显示对福利有益,也没有给出具体条件。

statement_en: Initial stocking density affects the acclimation to feeding and growth of juvenile yellowcheek fish.
statement_zh: 初始放养密度对黄颊鱼幼鱼的驯食和生长有影响。

practice_en: intensive acclimation to full artificial feed
statement_en: From day 11 to day 25, exclusively fed artificial feed, with intensive management to reinforce dietary adaptation.
statement_zh: 从第11天开始 exclusively 投喂人工饲料并持续至第25天，通过集约化管理强化饮食适应。

statement_en: The control group was fed to satiation twice daily, while the other three groups were fasted for 5 days, 10 days, and 14 days respectively before resuming feeding to satiation.
statement_zh: 对照组每天两次饱食投喂，而其余三组分别禁食5天、10天和14天后恢复饱食投喂。

statement_en: Scientists found through quantitative feeding trials that L-glutamate can rapidly promote food consumption.
statement_zh: 科学家通过定量摄食试验发现L-谷氨酸能迅速促进食物消耗。

statement_en: Two supportive claims from one paper suggest that Lactococcus helped mandarin fish accept and eat formulated feed. One, reported as background, says it affects palatability, gut microbiota and intestinal microvilli, and so raises feed intake; the other is the authors' hypothesis that it indirectly aided digestion and absorption and thereby growth. Neither claim gives conditions or measured effects.
statement_zh: 同一篇论文的两条支持性结论认为,乳球菌有助于鳜鱼接受并摄食配合饲料。一条是背景性引述,称其可影响饲料适口性、肠道菌群和肠绒毛形态,从而提高摄食量;另一条是作者的推测,认为它间接促进了配合饲料的消化吸收,进而促进个体生长发育。两条结论均未给出具体条件或实测效果。

statement_en: Adding leucine to feed was found to reduce food intake in golden pompano.
statement_zh: 饲料中添加亮氨酸被发现会减少金鲳鱼的食物摄入量。

practice_en: diets with different lipid and carbohydrate levels
practice_zh: 不同脂质和碳水化合物水平日粮
statement_en: Different dietary lipid and carbohydrate levels had no significant effect on the survival rate, final body weight, specific growth rate, feed intake, feed efficiency, and protein efficiency of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 不同的膳食脂质和碳水化合物水平对鳜鱼的存活率、终体重、特定生长率、摄食量、饲料效率和蛋白质效率没有显著影响。

statement_en: Only one claim reports an effect: in one study, dietary lipid levels of 80-160 g/kg did not affect the growth of mandarin fish, so the lowest level met their lipid requirement. The other two claims, from a second study, only describe the diets (2%, 7%, 12% and 17% lipid, fed to apparent satiation for five weeks) and report no welfare effect.
statement_zh: 只有一条结果报告了影响:一项研究中,饲料脂质水平为80-160 g/kg时对鳜鱼的生长没有影响,说明最低脂质水平即可满足其脂质需求。另外两条来自另一项研究,只是描述了试验饲料(脂质水平2%、7%、12%和17%,投喂至表观饱食,共五周),没有给出对福利的影响。

practice_en: replacing live bait with artificial feed
statement_en: For mandarin fish, the evidence here is thin: one measured pond study found that replacing live bait with formulated feed caused only slight gut microbiota changes and no change in overall community structure, while another paper only said that digestive physiology must be understood before substituting, citing good growth and survival in European sea bass (a different species) fed formulated feed in place of live feed.
statement_zh: 就鳜鱼而言，这里的证据很有限：一项池塘实测研究发现，用人工配合饲料替代活饵只引起肠道菌群轻微变化，整体群落结构没有改变；另一篇文献只是指出替代前需先弄清其消化生理，并引用了欧洲鲈（另一物种）用配合饲料完全替代活饵后生长和成活良好的结果。

practice_en: co-feeding live bait and artificial feed with gradual withdrawal
practice_zh: 活饵与人工饲料共投喂并逐步撤除活饵
statement_en: The results showed that when live bait was gradually withdrawn, co-feeding improved the growth of hybrid mandarin fish and increased the acceptability of artificial feed.
statement_zh: 结果表明，当逐渐撤除活饵时，共投喂改善了鳜杂交种的生长并提高了人工饲料的可接受性。

statement_en: Both claims, from one 2011 paper, describe how mandarin fish are moved from live to dead bait. They report that the switch can work with small test feedings, slow feeding to lengthen the falling time, and a gradual rise in the share of dead bait, with dead bait replacing live bait over days 8 to 10 of domestication. They give no welfare measures such as stress, injury or health, so they do not show an effect on welfare beyond the fish accepting dead bait.
statement_zh: 两条结论都来自同一篇2011年的论文,只是描述鳜鱼如何从活饵转为死饵:先建立良好的摄食反应,再通过少量试投、慢投以延长饵料下沉时间,并逐步提高死饵比例,在驯食的第8至10天逐日用死饵鱼替代活饵鱼。结论没有给出应激、损伤或健康等福利指标,因此除了鱼能接受死饵之外,看不出对福利有何影响。

practice_en: transition from live feed to formulated feed
statement_en: Significant phenotypic variation among individuals was observed during the domestication of S. chuatsi to formulated feed, despite overall successful domestication.
statement_zh: 在S. chuatsi驯化至配合饲料的过程中观察到个体间存在显著的表型变异，尽管整体驯化成功。

practice_en: live bait vs artificial feed comparison
statement_en: Studies comparing mandarin fish fed live bait with those fed artificial feed looked at gut microbiota, not at direct welfare outcomes. One study found different gut bacterial community structures between the two groups: alpha diversity did not differ significantly, but beta diversity did. The other study only describes investigating gut microbiota diversity under the two diets.
statement_zh: 有关鳜鱼投喂活饵与人工饲料的比较研究，主要考察的是肠道微生物，并未直接评价福利指标。其中一项研究发现两组鱼的肠道菌群结构不同：α多样性无显著差异，但β多样性差异显著；另一项研究仅描述了在这两种饲料下对肠道菌群多样性的调查。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, adding low-concentration protease (0.2 g/kg) to the feed did not significantly change feed intake, but it lowered expression of the appetite-promoting gene npy and raised expression of the appetite-suppressing gene pomc. The authors infer from this that it may harm feeding behaviour and growth performance. One claim words the gene result inconsistently, saying it promoted appetite-promoting genes.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼饲料中添加低浓度蛋白酶(0.2 g/kg),摄食量没有显著变化,但促食欲基因npy表达显著下降,抑食欲基因pomc表达显著上升。作者据此推测,这可能对鳜鱼的摄食行为和生长性能产生不利影响。其中一条结论对基因变化的表述前后不一致,写成了同时促进促食欲基因的表达。

statement_en: This study established a link between systemic amino acid sensing and the control of feeding by amino acids, providing a theoretical basis for farming with low-fish-meal diets.
statement_zh: 该研究建立了系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸对摄食控制之间的联系，为低鱼粉饲料养殖提供理论基础。

statement_en: In contrast, Group A (P/E ratio of 30.58 mg/kJ) mandarin fish showed the lowest growth performance, feed utilization, and body composition indices.
statement_zh: 相比之下，A组（P/E比为30.58 mg/kJ）的鳜鱼表现出最低的生长性能、饲料利用率和体成分指标。

practice_zh: 低蛋白高碳水或脂质日粮
statement_en: Similarly, in groups A and B, protein levels were below optimal levels, which may be the reason for low feed intake and palatability; that is, low dietary protein and high carbohydrate/lipid in the feed.
statement_zh: 同样，在A组和B组中，蛋白质水平低于最佳水平，这可能是采食量和适口性低的原因；即饲料中膳食蛋白低而碳水化合物/脂质高。

practice_en: maggot meal or maggot meal plus taurine
practice_zh: 添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸
statement_en: In mandarin fish, adding maggot meal or maggot meal plus taurine to the feed gave a numerically higher weight gain rate and lower feed conversion ratio than the control, but the differences were not significant. One claim still describes feed utilization efficiency as higher in the supplemented groups, so the evidence is weak and mixed.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼饲料中添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸后，增重率数值上高于对照组，饵料系数低于对照组，但差异均不显著。有一条结论认为添加组的饲料利用效率高于对照组，但整体证据较弱，结果不一致。

statement_en: The two claims point in different directions. In Chinese perch (mandarin fish), replacing fishmeal with housefly maggot meal had no significant negative impact on feeding, growth or muscle quality, and muscle amino acid content rose. In topmouth culter, a different species, replacing fishmeal with 18% maggot meal significantly reduced feeding rate, and adding taurine gave no significant difference from the control.
statement_zh: 两条结论并不一致。在鳜(Siniperca chuatsi)中,蝇蛆粉成功替代鱼粉后,对摄食、生长和肌肉品质没有显著不良影响,肌肉氨基酸含量还有所增加。而在另一种鱼——翘嘴红鲌中,用18%蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉会显著降低摄食率,添加牛磺酸后与对照组相比差异不显著。

practice_en: maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
practice_zh: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸
statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fishmeal with maggot meal lowered the feeding rate, and adding taurine brought it back to the level of the control group; taurine also raised the expression of the appetite-stimulating genes npy and ghrelin and lowered the appetite-suppressing gene pomcα. The explanations about hunger-driven behaviour and better palatability are speculative or inferred rather than directly measured.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中,用蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉会显著降低摄食率,添加牛磺酸后摄食率恢复到对照组水平;牛磺酸还上调了促食欲基因npy和ghrelin的表达,下调了抑食欲基因pomcα。至于其改善饥饿驱动行为和饲料适口性的说法,属于推测或推断,并非直接测得。

statement_en: The study found that fish were most attracted to moist particles with a length of 15 to 18 mm and a moisture content exceeding 30%.
statement_zh: 研究发现，鱼最被吸引的是长度在15到18毫米之间、含水量超过30%的湿润颗粒。

statement_en: Studies show that adding an appropriate amount of monosodium glutamate (MSG) to the diet may improve food intake.
statement_zh: 研究表明，在膳食中添加适量的味精（MSG）可能会改善食物摄入量。

statement_en: Rank abundance curve results showed that the natural feed group had higher abundance than the artificial feed group.

practice_en: net cage farming with formulated feed
practice_zh: 网箱养殖与配合饲料投喂
statement_en: Fully domesticated mandarin fish fry were placed in net cages and fed formulated feed throughout the experiment.
statement_zh: 完全驯化的鳜鱼苗种被放置在网箱中，并在整个实验期间投喂配合饲料。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, adding 1.6 g/kg protease improved weight gain, specific growth rate, feed intake and protein retention and lowered the feed conversion ratio. A background claim about Nile tilapia, not mandarin fish, reports mixed results: 0.2-0.4 g/kg neutral protease improved digestibility and gut structure, while 0.8 g/kg reduced digestibility and damaged intestinal villi.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，添加1.6 g/kg蛋白酶可提高增重率、特定生长率、摄食量和蛋白质沉积率，并降低饵料系数。另有一条背景性结论针对的是罗非鱼而非鳜鱼，结果不一：添加0.2-0.4 g/kg中性蛋白酶可提高表观消化率、改善肠道结构，而添加0.8 g/kg则使表观消化率下降并造成肠绒毛损伤。

statement_en: In one 2023 study, mandarin fish fed non-living and artificial feeds gained 1.5–2.1 times less weight than controls fed live fish, and needed 1.5–2.7 times more feed per unit of gain, so feeding performance was worse on these feeds. The claims do not state the specific feed types or rearing conditions.
statement_zh: 2023年的一项研究显示,用非活饵和人工饲料投喂鳜鱼,其绝对增重比投喂活鱼的对照组低1.5–2.1倍,单位增重的饲料消耗则高出1.5–2.7倍,说明摄食和生长表现较差。这些结论中没有说明具体的饲料种类和养殖条件。

statement_en: To obtain the maximum specific growth rate (SGR), the determined optimal dietary carbohydrate level was 10.93%.
statement_zh: 为获得最大特定生长率（SGR），确定的最佳膳食碳水化合物水平为10.93%。

statement_en: Both claims link palatable or suitable feed to survival of mandarin fish larvae and fry: one measured finding says larvae given no palatable feed during the mixed feeding stage all died within 6 to 7 days, and a 2008 claim says timely provision of suitable initial feed is a crucial factor in fry survival. No conditions beyond these are stated.
statement_zh: 两条结论都把适口饵料与鳜鱼苗的成活联系起来:一条实测结果显示,混合营养期仔鱼得不到适口饵料,6~7天内会全部死亡;另一条2008年的论述认为,及时投喂合适的开口饵料是影响鳜鱼苗成活率的关键因素。除此之外,结论中没有给出其他条件。

statement_en: In this study, compared to live bait fish feed, pellet feed altered the gut microbiota structure of mandarin fish, which may be mainly caused by changes in dietary composition and is also influenced by environmental stress (including dietary stress).
statement_zh: 在本研究中，与活饵鱼饲料相比，颗粒饲料改变了鳜鱼的肠道菌群结构，这可能主要由膳食结构变化引起，同时也受环境压力（包括饮食压力）的影响。

practice_en: pellet feed vs live bait comparison
statement_en: In one study comparing probiotic-free pellet feed with live bait in mandarin fish, survival at the end of the experiment was lower on the pellet feed. Pellet-fed fish also differed from live-bait fish in appetite-related gene expression: intestinal leptin mRNA was higher, while brain neuropeptide Y and agouti-related peptide mRNA were lower. The claims do not say what these gene changes mean for welfare, and one claim only describes the experimental groups.
statement_zh: 在一项比较无益生菌颗粒饲料与活饵投喂鳜鱼的研究中,试验结束时颗粒饲料组的成活率低于活饵组。与活饵组相比,颗粒饲料组鳜鱼肠道瘦素mRNA水平升高,脑内神经肽Y和刺鼠相关肽基因mRNA水平降低。这些基因变化对福利意味着什么,相关结论中并未说明,另有一条结论只是描述了试验分组。

statement_en: The phosphorus/energy ratio in artificial feed regulates the growth performance, feed intake, feed utilization, and body composition of mandarin fish by affecting protein synthesis, energy homeostasis, enzyme activity, and serum biochemical indicators.
statement_zh: 人工饲料中的磷/能比通过影响蛋白质合成、能量稳态、酶活性和血清生化指标，进而调节鳜鱼的生长性能、摄食量、饲料利用率和体成分。

statement_en: The two claims from one paper do not report a clear welfare benefit of replacing fishmeal with plant protein in mandarin fish. One notes that differences in essential amino acid content and ratios between the two are hard to reconcile, which has drawn attention to how amino acids regulate feeding. The other, an inference, suggests that feed intake gradually fell as the level of fishmeal replacement rose.
statement_zh: 这篇论文的两条结论并未显示用植物蛋白替代鱼粉对鳜鱼的福利有明确益处。一条指出植物蛋白与鱼粉在必需氨基酸含量和比例上的差异难以协调，因此人们开始关注必需氨基酸对摄食的调控机制；另一条是推测，认为摄食量可能随鱼粉替代比例的升高而逐渐下降。

practice_en: l. plantarum, l. rhamnosus, c. butyricum probiotics
practice_zh: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
statement_en: In mandarin fish with feeding disorders caused by pellet feed, adding L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus or C. butyricum raised pellet feed acceptance and survival compared with the same diet without probiotics. The probiotics also reversed the drop in brain agrp expression and in serum lysozyme and IgM; the link to appetite and gut microbiota is an inference by the authors, not a tested result.
statement_zh: 鳜在投喂颗粒饲料出现摄食障碍时,添加植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌或丁酸梭菌,与未添加益生菌的同一饲料组相比,颗粒料接受率和存活率均有提高。三种益生菌还逆转了脑内agrp表达以及血清溶菌酶和IgM的下降;其与食欲和肠道菌群调节的关系是作者的推断,并非直接验证的结果。

statement_en: The claims are mostly supportive: one study (S047) inferred that probiotics improved appetite in mandarin fish fed pellets, by lowering leptin and raising the central appetite-stimulating factors Npy/Agrp, while other claims are background statements that probiotics can affect feeding behaviour or ease problems with formulated diets. No claim reports conditions, doses or a null or negative result.
statement_zh: 这些结论基本都是正面的:其中一项研究(S047)推断,益生菌可通过降低瘦素表达、提高中枢促食欲因子Npy/Agrp的表达,改善投喂配合饲料的鳜鱼的食欲;其余多为背景性说法,即益生菌可影响摄食行为、缓解鳜鱼投喂配合饲料时的一些问题。这些结论均未给出具体条件或剂量,也没有无效或负面的结果。

statement_en: Only at a protease supplementation concentration of 1.6 g/kg were the protein efficiency ratio and protein retention value of mandarin fish significantly higher than those of the control group, while crude protein content was significantly lower than that of the control group.
statement_zh: 仅在1.6 g/kg的蛋白酶补充浓度下，鳜鱼的蛋白质效率比和蛋白质保留值显著高于对照组，而粗蛋白含量显著低于对照组。

statement_en: The addition of 1 g/kg protease to European sea bass feed based on 50% high-protein distillers' grains significantly improved body weight, specific growth rate and feed intake.
statement_zh: 在基于50%高蛋白酒糟的欧洲鲈鱼饲料中添加1克/公斤的蛋白酶显著改善了体重、特定生长率和摄食量。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, adding protease to feed (0.4–1.6 g/kg) generally raised feed intake, with P2 (the lowest level) the exception in some claims, though the feeding rate rose significantly only at 0.4 g/kg. Appetite-gene responses varied by dose and gene (npy and agrp were not consistently raised; pomc and cart fell at 0.8–1.6 g/kg), and low-dose groups had lower protein efficiency and retention, so the effect on feeding was dose-dependent and not uniform.
statement_zh: 在鲤科以外的鳜鱼上，饲料中添加0.4–1.6 g/kg蛋白酶总体上提高了摄食量（个别声明中最低添加组P2与对照无显著差异），但摄食率只在0.4 g/kg时显著升高。食欲相关基因的反应随剂量和基因而异（npy、agrp表达并不一致上调，0.8–1.6 g/kg时pomc、cart下调），低剂量组的蛋白质效率和蛋白质沉积率还低于对照，因此对摄食的影响与剂量有关，并不一致。

statement_en: The three claims describe how feed protein content relates to growth and feed use, and they do not fully agree. One reports that growth rises with protein at first but plateaus or falls once protein exceeds requirement, and another says protein that is too high or too low harms growth. A third, inferred, claim says higher protein improved feed efficiency, daily intake and protein conversion efficiency. None of them states the species or conditions, and they speak to growth and feed efficiency rather than welfare directly.
statement_zh: 三条结论说法不完全一致,都是讲饲料蛋白含量与生长、饲料利用的关系。一条称蛋白升高时生长先增加,超过需要量后生长持平或下降;另一条称蛋白过高或过低都不利于鱼的生长。第三条(推断性结论)称蛋白含量越高,饲料效率、日摄食率和蛋白转化效率越高。这些结论都没有说明具体养殖条件,讲的也是生长和饲料利用,并非直接的福利指标。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, five isoenergetic diets with different protein-to-energy ratios significantly changed expression of the appetite genes NPY and AgRP, but not CART or POMC. The authors also infer that a ratio above the optimum affects ammonia nitrogen production and muscle quality; the other claims are background or design description.
statement_zh: 在鳜上，5种等能日粮的不同蛋白能量比显著影响食欲相关基因NPY和AgRP的表达，但对CART和POMC的表达没有影响。作者还推断，蛋白能量比高于最适值时会影响氨氮产生和肌肉品质；其余结论为背景介绍或试验设计描述。

statement_en: Six soft pellet feeds with different protein gradients were prepared, and the experiment was conducted in 24 rearing units, each stocked with 30 experimental fish.
statement_zh: 研究制备了六个不同蛋白质梯度的软颗粒饲料，并在24个养殖单位中每单位饲养30尾实验鱼进行试验。

practice_en: high vs low protein diet comparison
statement_en: This means that fish fed a high-protein diet (45-55% dietary protein) utilize dietary protein more effectively than fish fed a low-protein diet (35%).
statement_zh: 这意味着喂食高蛋白日粮（45-55%膳食蛋白）的鱼比喂食低蛋白日粮（35%）的鱼更有效地利用膳食蛋白。

statement_en: The two claims only describe how mandarin fish were fed under quantitative feeding: broodstock kept in two standard cages on a rationed feeding regime, and fish fed at 1% of body weight at 9 a.m. Neither claim reports an effect on welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都只是描述鳜鱼的定量投喂做法:亲鱼养在两个标准网箱中按定量方式投喂,另一条是每天上午9点按体重1%投喂。两条都没有报告对鱼类福利的影响。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, a high-level rapeseed meal diet worsened feeding-related outcomes: feed conversion ratio was significantly higher and condition factor lower than in the other groups, and the authors infer insufficient energy intake. The claims disagree on appetite: one reports it was suppressed, while another found feed intake unaffected, which the authors suggest reflects fish eating enough to compensate for poorer feed utilisation.
statement_zh: 对鳜来说,高水平菜籽粕日粮使摄食相关指标变差:饲料系数显著高于其他组,肥满度较低,作者推测能量摄入不足。关于食欲,各条结论不一致:一条称食欲受到抑制,另一条则称摄食量未受影响,作者认为这可能是因为鱼对饲料利用能力较差,只能多摄食来满足自身需要。

statement_en: In one study, mandarin fish fed a low-level rapeseed meal diet ate significantly less than the other groups, and the authors link this to suppressed lipid metabolism in the liver and visceral fat, with the fish accepting the diet less well. One claim notes raised AgRP expression, read as an active appetite state, so appetite signals and actual intake pointed in different directions.
statement_zh: 在一项研究中,投喂低水平菜籽粕日粮的鳜摄食量明显低于其他组,作者认为这与肝脏和内脏脂肪的脂质代谢受抑制有关,说明鳜对该日粮的接受度较差。另有结论指出AgRP表达上调,提示这组鱼处于积极的食欲状态,可见食欲信号与实际摄食量并不一致。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with rapeseed meal changed the expression of appetite-related genes (NPY lower in the RSH group, AgRP higher in the RSL group, leptin A higher in the RSH group), but the claims only describe these gene changes and do not state a welfare outcome. Background text notes that rapeseed meal's poor palatability, anti-nutritional factors and amino acid imbalance can lead to poor appetite and slow growth in fish, which points to a possible feeding problem but is not a measured result here.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用菜籽粕替代鱼粉会改变与食欲相关的基因表达（RSH组NPY下调，RSL组AgRP上调，RSH组瘦素A上调），但这些结论只是描述基因表达变化，并未给出明确的福利结果。背景部分提到，菜籽粕适口性差、抗营养因子含量高且氨基酸不平衡，可能导致鱼类食欲差、生长慢，提示摄食方面可能存在问题，但这并不是本研究的实测结果。

statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, lowering the proportion of minced or trash fish in the feed was linked to lower body weight and slower growth over the first 97 days, which counts against this practice for feeding. Liver leptin and stomach ghrelin mRNA levels also rose as the proportion fell, but the claim only describes this change and does not say what it means for welfare.
statement_zh: 在一项针对杂交鳜的研究中,饲料中碎鱼(杂鱼)比例降低,前97天鱼的体重和生长速度随之下降,说明降低碎鱼比例对摄食/生长不利。同时,肝脏瘦素和胃部胨素(ghrelin)的mRNA水平随碎鱼比例下降而升高,但这一结果只是描述性的,并未说明对福利意味着什么。

statement_en: In natural water bodies, the availability and palatability of bait are crucial for the survival of juvenile Chinese perch; therefore, the type, density, and biomass of bait should be investigated to determine the release specifications for Chinese perch.
statement_zh: 在自然水体中，饵料的可用性和适口性对鳜鱼幼鱼的存活至关重要，因此应调查饵料的种类、密度和生物量以确定鳜鱼的放流规格。

statement_en: In reservoir cage culture, taming trials for 2-year-old mandarin fish using fresh fish, fish chunks, and formulated feed were all successful, with taming rates of 100%, 100%, and 88.4%, respectively.
statement_zh: 在水库网箱中对2龄鳜鱼进行鲜鱼、鱼块和配合饲料驯饲试验均获成功，驯化率分别为100%、100%和88.4%。

statement_en: Common carp and rainbow trout fed to 80% and 75% satiation, respectively, showed no significant difference in weight gain (WG) and specific growth rate (SGR) compared to the same species fed to 100% satiation.
statement_zh: 鲤鱼和虹鳟在分别投喂至80%和75%饱食度时，其体重增长（WG）和特定生长率（SGR）与投喂至100%饱食度的同种鱼类相比无显著差异。

statement_en: In this study, we used a pond-based rice floating bed (PRFB) system to rear mandarin fish using artificial feed.
statement_zh: 在本研究中，我们利用基于池塘的水稻浮床（PRFBs）系统使用人工饲料养殖鳜鱼。

statement_en: Regularly changing feed can avoid nutritional imbalance or drug resistance issues.
statement_zh: 定期更换饲料可避免营养不均衡或抗药性问题。

practice_en: feeding ratios at different satiation levels
statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, feeding at 100% satiation gave growth similar to feeding at 80% or more of satiation, and higher growth than feeding at 75% or 70%. Feed intake was similar at 90–100% satiation and higher than at 70–85%. Feed efficiency was lower at 100% than at 85% or less, but did not differ from 90–95%. Most blood and body composition measures did not change with feeding level, though total cholesterol tended to fall as feeding ratio decreased.
statement_zh: 在一项关于鳜的研究中，投喂至100%饱食度时的生长与投喂至80%及以上饱食度的相近，高于75%和70%饱食度组。90%～100%饱食度组的摄食量相近，且高于70%～85%组。饲料效率方面，100%组低于85%及以下组，但与90%、95%组无显著差异。多数血液指标和体成分不受投喂比例影响，仅总胆固醇随投喂比例降低有下降趋势。

statement_en: Artemia enriched with Schizochytrium has a certain potential for short-term replacement of natural feed during the initial feeding stage of Siniperca chuatsi.
statement_zh: 裂壶藻强化的卤虫在鳜初次摄食阶段具有一定的短期替代天然饵料的潜力。

statement_en: Из-за плохого подбора корма со дна, резаную рыбу вносили тремя порциями с интервалом 20–30 минут для обеспечения захвата в толще воды.

In one study of mandarin fish, researchers compared switching from live to dead baitfish with and without a dead-baitfish demonstrator, and reported that social learning promoted acquisition of the new feeding habit, with a significant effect on domestication and food intake. The other supporting claim is background on Atlantic salmon, not mandarin fish, and the claims give no specific conditions or figures.
statement_zh: 一项针对鳜鱼的研究比较了有无死饵鱼示范个体时,鳜从活饵转为摄食死饵的驯化情况,结果表明社会学习能促进鳜形成新的摄食习性,并对驯化和摄食量有显著影响。另一条支持性内容是关于大西洋鲑的背景报道,并非鳜鱼本身;这些结论中没有给出具体条件或数据。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, diets with soybean oil in place of fish oil led to significantly higher daily feed intake than diets with fish oil or linseed oil; both claims come from the same paper, and no other conditions are stated.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用大豆油替代鱼油的饲料，其日摄食量显著高于鱼油组和亚麻籽油组；两条结论均来自同一篇论文，未说明其他条件。

statement_en: Histological examination showed significantly increased lipid accumulation in the liver, while midgut villus length and muscular layer thickness reached their maximum values in the FM35 group.
statement_zh: 组织学检查显示肝脏脂质积累显著增强，而中肠绒毛长度和肌层厚度在FM35组达到最大值。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with soy protein concentrate hydrolysate (SPCH) worsened feeding-related outcomes: as the replacement level rose, feed intake, feed efficiency, protein efficiency and protein retention all fell in a linear, significant way, and above a 37.16% replacement ratio pept2 expression also dropped significantly. One further claim only describes the aims of the study and reports no effect.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用大豆浓缩蛋白水解物（SPCH）替代鱼粉会对摄食相关指标不利：随着替代水平升高，摄食量、饲料效率、蛋白质效率和蛋白质沉积率均呈显著线性下降；当替代比例超过37.16%时，pept2表达也显著下降。另有一条结论只是说明了试验目的，没有给出效果。

statement_en: During feeding, mandarin fish feed on mullet, while mullet are fed commercial feed at 8 a.m.
statement_zh: 在投喂期间，鳜以莫氏鲻为食，而莫氏鲻在上午8点投喂商业饲料。

statement_en: Through specific training procedures, some mandarin fish individuals are able to accept dead bait and artificial feed.
statement_zh: 经过特定的训练程序，部分鳜鱼个体能够接受死饵和人工饲料。

statement_en: Both claims describe staged diet-switching schedules for mandarin fish, moving from live fry to semi-comatose or near-dead bait, then dead, refrigerated bait and soft pellets. One paper says this helps fish gradually adapt to changes in diet form, but neither claim reports measured welfare outcomes.
statement_zh: 两项研究都只是介绍了鳜鱼分阶段驯化的投喂程序:先投活饵鱼苗,再换成半昏迷或濒死的饵料鱼,之后依次过渡到死饵、冷藏饵料和软颗粒饲料。其中一篇认为这样能让鱼逐步适应饵料形态的变化,但两条结论都没有给出实际测得的福利效果。

statement_en: Farms formulate scientific feed recipes based on growth stages and adopt a staged feeding strategy.
statement_zh: 养殖场根据生长阶段制定科学饲料配方并采用分段投喂策略。

statement_en: The direct domestication group had no feeding response in the initial stage, accompanied by fish death or disappearance and regurgitation behavior, until day 14 when they began to formally consume compound feed.
statement_zh: 直接驯化组初期无摄食反应，伴随鱼类死亡或失踪及反吐行为，直至第14天才开始正式摄食配合饲料。

practice_en: starvation direct training with fish chunks or feed
practice_zh: 饥饿直接驯化（鱼块/饲料）
statement_en: In the direct starvation domestication method, when fed fish chunks and compound feed, mandarin fish showed a response but did not eat, resulting in a domestication rate of zero.
statement_zh: 在饥饿直接驯化法中，投喂鱼块和配合饲料时，鳜鱼虽有反应但不摄食，驯化率为零。

statement_en: In juvenile mandarin fish, treatment with 20 mg/L trypsin inhibitor significantly reduced feeding rate, and it raised the appetite-suppressing factors CCK and POMC, while the appetite-stimulating factors NPY and AgRP showed no significant change. All four claims come from a single paper.
statement_zh: 在鳜幼鱼中，20 mg/L 胰蛋白酶抑制剂处理显著降低了摄食率，同时上调了抑制食欲的因子 CCK 和 POMC，而促进食欲的因子 NPY 和 AgRP 没有显著变化。这四条结论都来自同一篇论文。

statement_en: Adding tryptophan to the feed of growing carp promoted their food intake.
statement_zh: 在建鲤的饲料中添加色氨酸促进了其食物摄入量。

statement_en: One measured study found that feeding twice a day matched the fish's natural two-peak feeding rhythm and gave a better result in training them to accept feed. The other claim only describes a 10-week trial in which fish of about 114 g were fed twice daily with one of six experimental diets, and reports no welfare effect.
statement_zh: 一项实测研究显示，每天投喂2次符合鳜鱼自然的双峰摄食节律，驯化（驯食）效果更好。另一项研究只是描述了试验做法：平均体重约114 g的鱼，每天投喂2次、用6种试验饲料之一养10周，并未给出对福利的影响。

statement_en: Fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 9:00 and 17:00), with feed amount adjusted to 3-5% of total biomass.
statement_zh: 每天两次（9:00和17:00）投喂至表观饱食，饲料量调整为总生物量的3-5%。

statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish, wet pellets and mince did not work well as feed: 26–30% of the wet pellets were left uneaten in the trial cages, and although the fish ate dead, cut-up fish, most did not switch to eating mince or wet pellets. Both claims come from the same paper and point to poor acceptance of this feed.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜鱼的研究中,湿颗粒饲料和鱼糜的效果不理想:试验网箱中有26–30%的湿颗粒饲料没有被吃掉;鱼虽然能摄食死鱼和切块鱼,但大多数没有转食鱼糜和湿颗粒饲料。两条结论都来自同一篇论文,说明这类饲料的摄食接受度较差。

statement_en: Due to the overstocking of Chinese mitten crabs in recent years, submerged plants, one of their most important food resources, have gradually decreased.
statement_zh: 由于过去几年中华绒螯蟹的过度放养，作为其最重要食物资源之一的沉水植物逐渐减少。

statement_en: After transport stress, the antioxidant enzyme activity of mandarin fish fed CF was inhibited compared to that of mandarin fish fed LF.
statement_zh: 运输刺激后，与饲喂LF的鳜相比，饲喂CF的鳜的抗氧化酶活性受到抑制。

statement_en: The study found that mandarin fish fed CF retained more energy during transport and showed stronger resistance to microbial stress, but had weaker antioxidant capacity compared to mandarin fish fed LF.
statement_zh: 研究发现，用CF饲养的鳜在运输过程中能保留更多能量并表现出更强的抗微生物应激能力，但与投喂LF的鳜相比，其抗氧化能力较弱。

practice_zh: 盐碱水配合高碳水饲料
statement_en: When fish consume more carbohydrates or are farmed in saline-alkaline water, their osmotic pressure is higher, particularly in the comparison between the NC group and the HC1 group.
statement_zh: 当鱼摄入更多碳水化合物或在盐碱水中养殖时，其渗透压较高，特别是在NC组和HC1组的比较中。

statement_en: Both claims, from one 2025 paper, say that high-density farming of mandarin fish worsens water quality: ammonia-nitrogen fluctuates more and total ammonia-nitrogen often exceeds natural water levels because of metabolic waste, feed residues and microbial mineralization, so the fish face ammonia-nitrogen stress. The claims state no specific density or concentration, and no claim shows a neutral or positive effect.
statement_zh: 同一篇2025年论文的两条结论均指出,鳜鱼高密度养殖会使水质变差:代谢废物、残饵和微生物矿化的累积作用使氨氮波动加剧,总氨氮常常超过自然水体水平,鳜鱼因此面临氨氮胁迫。这些结论没有给出具体的养殖密度或氨氮浓度,也没有结论显示无影响或有益影响。

statement_en: Developing reasonable carbohydrate regulation strategies may be of great significance for promoting the adaptive capacity of fish under saline-alkali stress.
statement_zh: 制定合理的碳水化合物调控策略可能对促进鱼类在盐碱胁迫下的适应能力具有重要意义。

statement_en: The insights from this study will be used to improve low-temperature aquaculture feed for mandarin fish, aiming to reduce ammonia and nitrogen emissions, thereby advancing low-ammonia-emission aquaculture practices for this species.
statement_zh: 该研究的见解将用于改进鳜鱼低温养殖饲料，旨在减少氨和氮排放，从而推进该物种的低氨排放养殖实践。

statement_en: Aldehyde disinfectants have strong inactivation efficacy against MFBV, with glutaraldehyde being the most effective.
statement_zh: 醛类消毒剂对MFBV具有强灭活效力，其中戊二醛最有效。

statement_en: The claims, all supportive, say antibiotics are effective against bacterial disease in mandarin fish, especially nocardiosis: one advises treating early in bacterial disease, and another reports that the tested drugs, including ciprofloxacin, erythromycin, cefoperazone, kanamycin and gentamicin, appear effective, based on susceptibility patterns rather than measured welfare outcomes. One paper recommends continued monitoring for resistance, and a background claim cites other work listing further effective drugs for Nocardia in fish.
statement_zh: 这些结论均为支持性意见，认为抗生素对鳜的细菌性疾病尤其是诺卡氏菌病有效：一条建议在细菌病早期用药控制；另一条根据药敏结果推断，所检测的药物（包括环丙沙星、红霉素、头孢哌酮、卡那霉素和庆大霉素）可有效防治，但这是基于药敏模式的推断，并非直接测得的福利结果。该研究还建议持续监测耐药性的发展，另有背景文献提到其他对鱼类诺卡氏菌感染有效的药物。

practice_zh: 抗病毒技术/疫苗/药物开发
statement_en: Elucidating the infection and pathogenic mechanisms of fish rhabdoviruses is crucial for the construction of future antiviral technologies and the development of vaccines or antiviral drugs.
statement_zh: 揭示鱼类弹状病毒的感染和致病机制对于未来抗病毒技术的构建以及疫苗或抗病毒药物的开发至关重要。

statement_en: Unpublished data indicate that the attenuated live MRV vaccine (but not the inactivated MRV vaccine) provided effective protection against challenge with virulent MRV in a mandarin fish model.
statement_zh: 未发表的数据表明，减毒活MRV疫苗（而非灭活MRV疫苗）在鳜鱼模型中提供了针对强毒力MRV攻击的有效保护。

statement_en: Infections caused by bacteria such as Aeromonas hydrophila were excluded by species-specific PCR detection.
statement_zh: 通过物种特异性PCR检测排除了嗜水气单胞菌等细菌引起的感染。

statement_en: Recently, our laboratory developed an ISKNV-SCRV bivalent inactivated vaccine that provides protection against both ISKNV and SCRV infections, with protection rates exceeding 90% and 80%, respectively.
statement_zh: 最近，我们的实验室开发了一种ISKNV-SCRV二价灭活疫苗，可同时对ISKNV和SCRV感染提供保护，保护率分别超过90%和80%。

statement_en: BPTES and EGCG inhibited ISKNV replication, indicating that they or their analogues may be promising compounds for preventing ISKNV infection.
statement_zh: BPTES和EGCG抑制了ISKNV的复制，表明它们或其类似物可能是预防ISKNV感染的有前景的化合物。

practice_en: inactivated vaccine from highly permissive cell lines
practice_zh: 高容许性细胞系开发灭活疫苗
statement_en: Cytomegalovirus inactivated vaccines against Red Sea bream iridovirus (RSIV-I), infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV-I), and RSIV-II have been developed using highly permissive cell lines derived from mandarin fish juvenile-1 (MFF-1) or grouper fin (GF).
statement_zh: 利用鳜鱼幼鱼-1（MFF-1）或石首鱼鳍（GF）的高容许性细胞系，已开发出针对红海鲷虹彩病毒（RSIV-I）、传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV-I）和RSIV-II的巨细胞病毒灭活疫苗。

statement_en: C-I20 significantly reduced multi-type tissue damage.
statement_zh: C-I20显著减少了多类型组织损伤。

practice_zh: 载CiCXCL20a羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒
statement_en: Carboxymethyl chitosan nanoparticles loaded with the bioactive protein CiCXCL20a can effectively prevent bacterial diseases in grass carp.
statement_zh: 负载生物活性蛋白CiCXCL20a的羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒能有效预防草鱼细菌性疾病。

practice_en: copper sulfate and ferrous sulfate bath
statement_en: Disinfection treatment of mandarin fish fry during the rearing period using a mixture of copper sulfate and ferrous sulfate is effective.
statement_zh: 使用硫酸铜和硫酸亚铁混合剂对培育期间的鳜鱼苗进行消毒治疗效果较好。

statement_en: These results indicate that this method can detect MRV at levels as low as 1 copy/μL and ISKNV at levels as low as 0.1 copy/μL.
statement_zh: 这些结果表明该方法可检测低至1 copy/μL的MRV和0.1 copy/μL的ISKNV。

statement_en: By alleviating oxidative stress and potentially limiting gill damage, this response helps protect the function of excretory organs.
statement_zh: 通过缓解氧化应激并潜在限制鳃损伤，这种反应有助于保护排泄器官的功能。

statement_en: The results showed that when cells were treated with DCA, both the intracellular ISKNV genome copy number and mature virus particles in the supernatant decreased at 36 and 48 hours post-infection, with the intracellular ISKNV genome copy number significantly decreasing by 57% at 48 hours.
statement_zh: 结果显示，当用DCA处理细胞时，在感染后36小时和48小时，细胞内ISKNV基因组拷贝数和上清液中成熟病毒颗粒均减少，其中48小时时细胞内ISKNV基因组拷贝数显著减少了57%。

statement_en: The claims describe diagnostic testing rather than a welfare effect: RT-PCR and PCR screening found mandarin fish and bait fish free of RGNNV, ISKNV, MRV, SCRV and MFBV, and histopathology with 16S rRNA sequencing identified Nocardia as the cause of one disease outbreak. None of the claims report how these methods changed fish welfare.
statement_zh: 这几条结果都只是描述病原诊断检测本身，并未说明对鳜鱼福利的影响：RT-PCR和PCR筛查显示鳜鱼及饵料鱼未检出RGNNV、ISKNV、MRV、SCRV和MFBV，组织病理学结合16S rRNA基因测序则确定诺卡氏菌是一次发病的病原。没有一条结果报告这些检测方法使鱼的福利发生了什么变化。

statement_en: In the farming of economically valuable fish, disease monitoring becomes crucial because early detection of viral infections allows for rapid control measures.
statement_zh: 在经济价值鱼类的养殖中，疾病监测变得至关重要，因为早期检测病毒感染允许采取迅速的控制措施。

statement_en: Both claims, from a single 2025 paper, only describe testing how sensitive mandarin fish birnavirus (MFBV) is to various disinfectants, with the aim of reducing outbreaks; they give no results on fish welfare or disease levels, and no conditions or effect sizes.
statement_zh: 两条结论均出自同一篇2025年的论文,只是介绍了对鳜传染性脾肾坏死以外的鳜鱼双RNA病毒(MFBV)进行多种消毒剂敏感性测试,目的是减少疫病暴发;并未给出对鱼类福利或发病情况的实际效果,也没有说明具体条件或效果大小。

statement_en: For Nocardia infection in mandarin fish (S. chuatsi), the recommended treatment regimen is enrofloxacin and doxycycline as first choice, with florfenicol and sulfamethoxazole as alternatives.
statement_zh: 针对鳜鱼（S. chuatsi）的诺卡氏菌感染，推荐的治疗方案首选恩诺沙星和多西环素，备选方案为氟苯尼考和磺胺甲噁唑。

statement_en: The claims describe a dual LAMP-HNB assay that detects Aeromonas hydrophila and ISKNV together in mandarin fish, with a lowest detection limit of 100 fg for each pathogen and 1 pg for mixed templates. Results can be read by eye with only ordinary heating equipment, and the authors say it could help pick up low-level or early infections. These are detection performance results only; no claim reports an effect on fish welfare or disease outcomes.
statement_zh: 这些结论介绍了一种双重LAMP-HNB检测方法，可同时检测鳜的嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV），对两种病原的最低检测限均为100 fg，混合模板为1 pg。该方法只需普通加热设备，肉眼即可判读结果，作者认为有助于发现低水平感染或早期感染。以上都是检测性能方面的结果，没有结论报告其对鱼体福利或发病结果的实际影响。

statement_en: A repeat experiment of DXMS treatment on 20隐性 MRV mandarin fish resulted in a cumulative mortality rate of 50% (10/20).
statement_zh: 对20只隐性MRV鳜鱼进行DXMS处理的重复实验导致累计死亡率为50%（10/20）。

statement_en: Exogenous probiotics are widely used in aquaculture due to their significant antibacterial properties against common pathogenic bacteria and fungi.
statement_zh: 外源益生菌因其对常见致病细菌和真菌的显著抗菌特性而被广泛应用于水产养殖。

statement_en: After immunizing Mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) with the inactivated Flavobacterium columnare vaccine FKG4, the mRNA expression levels of the three regulatory subunits of NADPH oxidase (p40phox, p47phox, and p67phox) increased significantly in specific tissues.
statement_zh: 使用柱状黄杆菌灭活苗FKG4对翘嘴鳜进行免疫后，其NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基（p40phox、p47phox、p67phox）在特定组织中的mRNA表达量显著上升。

practice_zh: 基于片段大小的病原鉴定
statement_en: Pathogens are identified by the specific DNA fragment sizes appearing after enzymatic digestion (182/171/163 bp corresponding to Aeromonas hydrophila, 136/117/96 bp corresponding to ISKNV, and the coexistence of all six corresponding to mixed infection).
statement_zh: 通过酶切后出现的特定DNA片段大小（182/171/163 bp对应嗜水气单胞菌，136/117/96 bp对应ISKNV，六者共存对应混合感染）来鉴定病原体。

statement_en: Previous research results indicate that the G protein DNA vaccine can provide higher immune protection against SCRV disease.
statement_zh: 先前的研究结果表明，G蛋白DNA疫苗可以对SCRV疾病产生更高的免疫保护。

statement_en: Hepcidin treatment significantly increased the survival rate of grass carp infected with Flavobacterium columnare and T. fasciatus infected with Vibrio anguillarum.
statement_zh: 铁调素处理可显著提高感染柱状黄杆菌的草鱼和感染鳗弧菌的T. fasciatus的存活率。

statement_en: In cell culture experiments, hesperetin pretreatment raised the red JC-1 fluorescence signal (a sign of mitochondrial membrane potential) in SCRV-infected cells, and it blocked virus adsorption or entry, which interfered with progeny virus replication in EPC cells. Both claims come from one paper and are cell-based measurements, so they do not show effects on live mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 在细胞实验中，橙皮素预处理提高了SCRV感染细胞的JC-1红色荧光信号（提示线粒体膜电位升高），并阻断了病毒的吸附或入侵，从而干扰了EPC细胞中子代病毒的复制。两条结论都来自同一篇论文的细胞水平检测，并未显示对活体鳜鱼的作用。

statement_en: In one 2025 study, hesperetin showed antiviral activity against Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV): it reduced cytopathic effect, progeny virus titers and SCRV N protein expression, and the authors suggest it as a candidate drug for controlling fish rhabdovirus. The claims report laboratory measures of viral inhibition and do not describe effects on disease in live fish or the conditions of use.
statement_zh: 一项2025年的研究表明，橙皮素对鳜弹状病毒（SCRV）有抗病毒作用：可减轻细胞病变效应，降低子代病毒滴度，并减少SCRV N蛋白的表达，作者认为它有望成为防控鱼类弹状病毒的候选药物。不过这些结果只是实验室层面的病毒抑制指标，并未说明对活体鱼发病情况的影响，也未给出使用条件。

statement_en: However, when the intensity of methyltestosterone treatment was too high, the survival rate of the treated group was significantly lower than that of the control group.
statement_zh: 然而，当甲基睾酮的处理强度过高时，处理组的存活率显著低于对照组。

statement_en: The claims are mostly background and descriptive: raised superoxide anion production after immunostimulant exposure is described as beneficial against pathogens (reported for shrimp), and O2- production is described as a measure of immunostimulant efficacy. For mandarin fish, one claim says fish in Taoyuan Reservoir had higher SOD activity than those in two other sites after exposure to immunostimulants, which was considered beneficial; none of the claims directly report disease or parasite outcomes.
statement_zh: 这几条结论大多是背景性或描述性的：有报道称虾类接触免疫刺激剂后超氧阴离子产生增加，对抵御病原有益，O2-产生量也被用来衡量免疫刺激剂的效果。对鳜鱼而言，只有一条结论提到，接触免疫刺激剂后桃源水库的鳜SOD活性高于另外两个地点（灵津滩、五强溪），被认为有益；但没有任何一条直接报告疾病或寄生虫方面的结果。

statement_en: Drawing on strategies against cytomegalovirus, inactivated vaccines may provide a promising solution.
statement_zh: 借鉴针对巨细胞病毒的策略，灭活疫苗可能提供一种有前景的解决方案。

practice_en: inactivated vaccine or non-lethal live virus exposure
practice_zh: 灭活疫苗或非致死活病毒暴露
statement_en: Therefore, both inactivated vaccines and non-lethal live virus exposure can elicit strong immune protection against virulent ISKNV/RSIV infection or reinfection.
statement_zh: 因此，无论是灭活疫苗还是非致死性活性病毒暴露都能引发对强毒力ISKNV/RSIV感染或再感染的强大免疫保护。

statement_en: This study revealed the different gut microbiota adaptive responses of mandarin fish to feed and aquaculture environments, providing microbiological theoretical support for optimizing healthy aquaculture management of mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 本研究揭示了鳜鱼对饲料和水产养殖环境不同的肠道微生物适应性反应，为优化鳜鱼健康养殖管理提供了微生态学理论支持。

statement_en: The claims, all reported as background, say an inactivated ISKNV vaccine for mandarin fish has been developed and licensed in mainland China (veterinary drug certificate in 2020), with an absolute protection rate of 90%. It is also said to work similarly well against various ISKNV genotype isolates in Asian sea bass and spotted sea bass; no conditions or negative findings are given.
statement_zh: 这些论文都是在背景介绍中提到，针对鳜的灭活ISKNV疫苗已研发成功，并在中国大陆获批商业使用（2020年取得兽药证书），绝对保护率为90%。另有说法称该疫苗对ISKNV种内多种基因型毒株在大口黑鲈（花鲈）和斑鳜以外的亚洲海鲈、大口黑鲈中也有相近的高效力；这些说法未给出具体条件，也没有负面结果。

practice_en: inactivated isknv vaccine with chitosan adjuvant
statement_en: Zhang et al. [6] developed an inactivated ISKNV vaccine adjuvanted with chitosan, which showed significant protective effects against ISKNV infection.
statement_zh: Zhang等人[6]开发了一种以壳聚糖为佐剂的灭活ISKNV疫苗，该疫苗对ISKNV感染具有显著的保护作用。

practice_zh: 细菌分离鉴定与16S rDNA PCR
statement_en: Bacteria were isolated and purified from multiple tissues of diseased mandarin fish, and identified using 16S rDNA PCR amplification technology.
statement_zh: 通过从患病鳜多组织取样、细菌培养分离纯化，并结合16S rDNA PCR扩增技术进行细菌学鉴定。

statement_en: The existing LAMP lateral flow dipstick system for ISKNV detection has reached a sensitivity of 10 copies/μL.
statement_zh: 现有的用于ISKNV检测的LAMP侧流试纸条系统已达到10 copies/μL的灵敏度。

statement_en: The two claims only describe LAMP as a detection tool: it is widely used in aquaculture to detect parasites, bacteria and viruses, and a LAMP method for largemouth bass virus reached a sensitivity of 8.55 copies/μL. Neither claim reports an effect on the welfare of mandarin fish or on disease levels in the animals.
statement_zh: 这两条结论只是介绍LAMP技术作为检测手段:它在水产养殖中已被广泛用于检测寄生虫、细菌和病毒,针对大口黑鲈虫病毒的LAMP检测方法灵敏度达到8.55 copies/μL。两条都没有说明该技术对鳜鱼福利或发病情况有何影响。

statement_en: Soaking fish fry with lipopolysaccharide can provide a certain degree of immune protection.
statement_zh: 使用脂多糖浸泡鱼苗可获得一定程度的免疫保护力。

statement_en: The method for preventing and controlling water mold disease is to use 1 ppm malachite green for disinfection daily for 10 days, by closing the inlet valve, adding the medicinal solution, stirring, and then slowly diluting and draining it out.
statement_zh: 防治水霉病的方法是每天使用1ppm孔雀石绿消毒，持续10天，通过关闭进水阀加入药液搅拌后缓慢稀释流出的方式操作。

practice_zh: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射
statement_en: In one paper, injecting mandarin fish with an adjuvant-free inactivated MRV vaccine was linked to deaths rather than protection: three fish died within 12 days, and in a repeat test on 20 latently infected fish, 7 (35%) died. The authors inferred from qPCR viral load changes that the vaccine reactivated latent MRV and partly contributed to the deaths.
statement_zh: 在一篇研究中,给鳜鱼腹腔注射无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗不仅没有体现出保护作用,反而伴随死亡:3尾鱼在接种后12天内死亡;在20尾潜伏感染鱼的重复试验中,累计死亡7尾(35%)。作者根据qPCR检测到的病毒载量变化推断,该疫苗激活了潜伏的MRV,对死亡起到了部分作用。

statement_en: This study showed that the water-in-oil formulation of inactivated MRV vaccine produced similar consequences (i.e., induced mass mortality) for latent MRV.
statement_zh: 本研究表明，油包水配方的灭活MRV疫苗对隐性MRV也产生了类似的后果（即诱导大量死亡）。

statement_en: In one 2011 study, mSDP treatment at 5, 10, 20 and 30 μM reduced ISKNV viral infection by 75%, 90%, 95% and 98% compared with untreated controls, with infection measured as the percentage of positive cells. The other claim only describes how infection was quantified.
statement_zh: 2011年的一项研究中,用5、10、20和30 μM的mSDP处理,与未处理对照组相比,可使ISKNV病毒感染分别降低75%、90%、95%和98%,感染程度以阳性细胞百分比计算。另一条结论只是说明了感染的统计方法。

statement_en: Zhang et al. [7] reported a cloned sea bass rhabdovirus Sanxi-7 (MSRV-SS-7) strain as a potential live vaccine candidate against SCRV disease.
statement_zh: Zhang等人[7]报道了一种克隆鲈鱼弹状病毒三水-7（MSRV-SS-7）株，作为对抗SCRV疾病的潜在活疫苗候选物。

practice_zh: 寄生虫检查与细菌分离鉴定
statement_en: Through microscopic examination and bacterial isolation and identification, no parasites or dominant pathogenic bacteria were found, thereby ruling out the possibility of parasitic disease and bacterial disease.
statement_zh: 通过显微镜检查和细菌分离鉴定，未发现寄生虫或优势致病菌，从而排除了寄生虫病和细菌病的可能性。

statement_en: Before the experiment, random sampling testing by qPCR confirmed that mandarin fish had no asymptomatic MRV carriers.
statement_zh: 实验前通过qPCR随机抽样检测，确认鳜鱼无无症状MRV携带者。

practice_zh: 入池前健康检查与筛选
statement_en: Before being placed into the tank, the fish underwent a thorough injury and disease check, and healthy individuals of uniform size were selected.
statement_zh: 在放入水箱之前，对鱼进行了彻底的伤病检查，并选择了大小均匀的健康个体。

statement_en: Probiotics have become a substitute for antibiotics and other drug treatments in aquaculture, and are regarded as a new tool for disease control.
statement_zh: 益生菌已成为水产养殖业中抗生素和其他药物治疗的替代品，并被视为疾病控制的新工具。

statement_en: One 2025 paper claims that drug use in mandarin fish should follow a prevention-first principle, and that preventive medication in the high-incidence season can reduce pathogen numbers and infection risk. These are supportive claims only; no measured welfare outcomes or doses are given.
statement_zh: 一篇2025年的论文提出，鳜鱼用药应遵循“预防为主”的原则，并认为在发病高发季节进行预防性用药可以减少病原数量、降低感染风险。这些只是支持性的说法，没有给出具体的福利效果数据或用药剂量。

statement_en: Before the experiment, fish were maintained for at least 2 weeks and confirmed to be uninfected with ISKNV by PCR.
statement_zh: 实验前，鱼至少维持了2周，并通过PCR确定未感染ISKNV。

statement_en: Fish were placed in quarantine tanks for one week for acclimation to laboratory rearing conditions, and randomly sampled for PCR testing to confirm MRV negativity.
statement_zh: 鱼类被放置在隔离水箱中一周以进行检疫和适应实验室养殖条件，并随机采样进行PCR检测以确认MRV阴性。

statement_en: The claims, all from one 2024 paper, describe an RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection method for MRV and ISKNV in mandarin fish. It detected MRV down to 1 copy/μL and ISKNV down to 0.1 copy/μL with good specificity and repeatability, and the authors suggest it could support early diagnosis and disease prevention and control; no effect on fish welfare was measured.
statement_zh: 这些结论都来自同一篇2024年的论文,介绍了一种用于检测鳜MRV和ISKNV的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a方法。该方法对MRV最低可检出1拷贝/μL,对ISKNV最低可检出0.1拷贝/μL,特异性和重复性良好,作者认为可用于早期诊断以及疾病的防控;但研究并未测定其对鱼类福利的实际影响。

statement_en: Therefore, developing new and rapid virus detection technologies is crucial for the prevention and control of MRV and ISKNV diseases.
statement_zh: 因此，开发新型、快速的病毒检测技术对于预防和控制MRV和ISKNV疾病至关重要。

statement_en: In addition, reasonable, scientific and standardized drug use should be carried out to control and reduce [antibiotic resistance/disease].
statement_zh: 此外，应进行合理、科学和规范的药物使用，以控制和减少[耐药性/疾病]。

statement_en: In one 2012 paper, the siRNA si983, which targets the N gene, reduced viral titer more than the other siRNAs tested and the control, and it was inferred to lower SCRV transmission and delay cytopathic effects. The claims give no conditions and report no disease or welfare outcomes in live fish.
statement_zh: 一篇2012年的研究显示,靶向N基因的si983在所测试的siRNA中降低病毒滴度的效果最好,优于对照组,并据此推断它能明显抑制SCRV传播、延缓细胞病变出现。这些结论没有给出具体条件,也没有报告活体鳜的发病或福利方面的结果。

statement_en: Both claims describe saltwater immersion as a disinfection step before fish are stocked: broodstock are bathed in a 5‰ salt solution before going into concrete tanks for pre-spawning conditioning, and the bath can kill pathogens on the body surface. The claims do not report measured disease or parasite outcomes in the fish, and they do not mention any negative or null effects.
statement_zh: 两条证据都只是介绍放养前的盐水浸浴消毒:亲鱼在进入水泥池进行产前培育前,先用5‰的盐水浸浴;盐水浸浴可以杀灭体表病原体。这些证据没有给出鱼体发病或寄生虫感染情况的实测结果,也没有提到不良影响或无效的情况。

statement_en: These results indicate that ScHSP60 stimulates an immune response to protect fish from damage caused by Aeromonas hydrophila.
statement_zh: 这些结果表明，ScHSP60刺激免疫反应以保护鱼类免受嗜水气单胞菌造成的损害。

statement_en: Controlling secondary bacterial infections may be an effective strategy to reduce the overall mortality of hemorrhagic diseases in aquaculture.
statement_zh: 控制继发性细菌感染可能是降低水产养殖中出血性疾病总体死亡率的有效策略。

statement_en: Virus testing of seedlings before introduction to exclude pathogens.
statement_zh: 引进前对苗种进行病毒检测以排除病原体。

statement_en: In one 2025 paper on mandarin fish, seedling disease prevention and control was reported to raise survival to over 90% and to give seedlings stronger disease resistance and growth potential. The claims give no further conditions and show no disagreement or null results.
statement_zh: 一篇2025年的鳜鱼研究报道,苗种防控技术使苗种成活率提高到90%以上,并使苗种的抗病力和生长潜力更强。这些结论没有说明其他具体条件,也没有出现不一致或无效应的结果。

statement_en: When selecting seedlings, observe that the body surface is free of damage and that swimming activity is lively; avoid inbreeding or toxic seedlings.
statement_zh: 选苗时应观察体表无损伤和游动活泼度，避免近亲繁殖或带毒苗种。

statement_en: Soaking in 3%-5% salt water or povidone-iodine for 5-10 minutes before stocking can kill pathogens on the body surface.
statement_zh: 放养前用3%-5%盐水或聚维酮碘浸泡消毒5-10分钟，可杀灭体表病原体。

statement_en: Parasite detection was performed on the gill filaments, fin rays, and other parts of diseased mandarin fish using the water immersion smear microscopic examination method.
statement_zh: 采用水浸片显微镜检测方法对患病鳜的鳃丝和鳍条等部位进行寄生虫检测。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, susceptibility testing of the bacterial strains isolated in two papers showed sensitivity to several drug classes (nine antibiotics in one study, including enrofloxacin, doxycycline, florfenicol and sulfamethoxazole; 14 of 30 drugs in the other), alongside resistance to others (cefuroxime, polymyxin B, amoxicillin and carbenicillin in one; 16 of 30 drugs including penicillin and ampicillin in the other). The claims only report in-vitro drug sensitivity and resistance of the strains, not any effect on fish health or disease outcomes, and the two papers differ on some drugs, for example polymyxin B and carbenicillin.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼上，两篇论文对分离到的病原菌做了药敏试验：一篇显示对9种抗菌药敏感（包括恩诺沙星、多西环素、氟苯尼考和磺胺甲噁唑），另一篇30种药物中对14种敏感；同时也有耐药，一篇对头孢呋辛、多粘菌素B、阿莫西林和羧苄西林耐药，另一篇对包括青霉素、氨苄西林在内的16种药物耐药。这些结果只是体外药物敏感与耐药情况，并未报告对鱼体健康或发病结局的影响，而且两篇在个别药物上结果不一致，例如多粘菌素B和羧苄西林。

practice_en: temperature stress, vaccination and dxms treatment
statement_en: After qPCR confirmed that surviving fish had entered a persistent infection state, vaccination and DXMS treatment were performed.
statement_zh: 通过qPCR确认幸存鱼进入持续感染状态后，进行了疫苗接种和DXMS处理。
